verses.mystical_translation: Help, the Living Presence; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
The the Living Presence shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the the Living Presence; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
The words of the the Living Presence are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
Thou shalt keep them, O the Living Presence, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
The patterns rooted in harm walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

contemplative_note: Words can either manufacture domination or become shelter for people pushed aside.
safety_note: The text condemns exploitation and manipulative speech; it must not be weaponized to silence disagreement or vulnerable speakers.
